speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely exacerbated by insufficient intake relative to growth, though physiological jaundice persists).

I have noted you are a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed female with increasing jaundice over the last two days. Your weight gain is excellent, which is reassuring. To rule out pathological causes like biliary atresia or hemolysis, I need to see your serum bilirubin levels and liver function tests. REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Liver_Function_Panel, CBC.
